Room.title: Room
Room.description: Multiplayer game room controlled by a host/teacher for up to 25 students.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the multiplayer session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last room state transition.

countdownStartedAt.description: Server timestamp when synchronized 3-2-1-GO countdown began.

startTime.description: Server timestamp when active gameplay began.

endTime.description: Server timestamp when the host ended the game.

challengeSeed.description: Deterministic seed ensuring identical challenge order for all players in the room.

roundNumber.description: Current session round number, incremented when host triggers Play Again.

playerCount.description: Current number of joined students in the room.

Player.title: Player
Player.description: Student participant inside a multiplayer room.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

normalizedKey.description: Hex/safe slug key corresponding to the student's unique name lock.

avatarColor.description: Hex color for player avatar badge.

completed.description: Challenges completed in current level (0 to 15).

totalCompleted.description: Total challenges completed across all levels in the round.

status.description: Connection or elimination state of the player.

roundNumber.description: Round number matching the room's current round.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student joined.

lastSeen.description: Server timestamp of the player's latest heartbeat.

PlayerNameLock.title: PlayerNameLock
PlayerNameLock.description: Atomic uniqueness lock preventing duplicate student names in the same room.

uid.description: UID of the student holding this name lock.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Multiplayer game room state, host metadata, shared seed, and synchronized timers.

/rooms/{roomCode}/players/{playerId}.description: Individual student state, score, lives, level, and connection status inside a room.

/rooms/{roomCode}/names/{nameKey}.description: Uniqueness lock ensuring no two students in the same room share the same name.
